notes.title: 🌿 AWAY: The Survival Series - Update v1.11 Now Live on Steam! 🌿
notes.notes:
🌿 [b]AWAY: The Survival Series - Update v1.11 Now Live on Steam![/b] 🌿

Hello, wilderness explorers!

We're excited to bring you the latest patch for AWAY: The Survival Series - Version 1.11, now available on Steam. This update brings a mix of bug fixes and an exciting new feature that we hope you'll love!

[b]What's New:[/b]

- 🐱 [b]Cat Mode Unleashed:[/b] Now, you can roam the wilderness as a cat in exploration mode. Experience the world from a whole new perspective!
- 🖥️ [b]VSync Option Added:[/b] For a smoother gameplay experience on Windows.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Various achievements system enhancements completed.
- Fast travel issues addressed.
- Snail achievement and hologram issues in exploration mode rectified.
- Localization improvements.
- Xbox icon display issues fixed.
- Enhanced NPC 3Cs for better gameplay comfort.
- Scorpion collision and attack animation bugs fixed.
- ...and several other minor fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. These updates are for you, and we hope they make your adventure in AWAY even more thrilling. Don't forget to share your cat adventures with us!

Happy exploring!

The AWAY Team 🍃

notes.title: Exciting New Update! Version 1.10 Out Now! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow gamers! 🎮

We're thrilled to announce the release of Version 1.10 for our game on Steam! This update is packed with improvements, bug fixes, and a brand new feature that we're sure you'll love. Get ready to experience the game like never before!

[h1]Introducing the Skin Feature! 💥[/h1]
Customize your character with unique and stylish skins, making your gameplay experience even more personalized and fun!

[h1]Major Improvements: 🛠️[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Enhanced NPC control, collisions, and ragdoll
[*]     Smoother locomotion and camera control
[*]     Default camera now slower and further away for a more comfortable gaming experience
[*]     Improved jumping camera movement for seamless action
[*]     Advanced NPC AI behaviors for more engaging interactions
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes Galore! 🐛[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Audio and stability fixes in exploration mode
[*]     Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay
[*]     Bug fixes for progression-related bugs in main quests, achievements, HUD, UI, statistics, save games, fast travel, side quests, and progression trees and skills
[*]     Better subtitle timing for hologram videos
[/list]

This update is all about enhancing your gaming experience and fixing those pesky issues that could have been getting in the way of your fun. We can't wait for you to dive into Version 1.10 and see all the improvements for yourself! As always, we appreciate your continued support, and we're eager to hear your feedback.

So, what are you waiting for? Update your game now and let the adventure continue! 🌟

Happy gaming,
Breaking Walls Team

notes.title: Message from the Devs - Quick Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We’d like to apologize for the major bugs that some players have encountered at launch. We are serious about addressing these issues and have begun working on (and even fixed) many of them already.

As a small indie shipping our first game, we decided to launch on multiple platforms and in multiple languages. This should not have been done at the expense of our game’s quality and experience.

Over the past 5 years, our small team has put our hearts and souls into creating this game. We want it to be the best experience it can be. We are going to continue listening to you and making improvements.

[b]Our sole focus right now is bug fixes and making game improvements. [/b]We’ve been working long hours to push patches as quickly as we can. If you are experiencing any bugs, or just want to share some feedback with us, [url=https://notionforms.io/forms/notion-form-bug-reporting]you can make a report here[/url]. It will be sent straight to the dev team for review. We’d like to extend a big thanks to everyone who’s filled out the form already, you have helped us make a better game. 

You can expect more patches and fixes in the weeks and months to come.


Our latest patch takes care of the following:

[list]
[*] Fixed respawn bugs and broken animation/control
[*] Improved sound and music
[*] Improved collisions and dynamics
[*] Improved setting controls, and saving
[*] Improve statistics, skills, and achievements
[*] Polished various missions
[*] Other minor stability, guidance, and cosmetic improvements
[*] Exploration Mode enters Beta: We have decided to denote Exploration Mode as a Beta thanks to your feedback. We have improvements in mind that we will begin experimenting with over the months to come. 
[*] Fixed crashes in Exploration Mode
[/list]

More improvements are coming soon! We can’t thank you enough for the patience you’ve shown us so far. 

Breaking Walls

notes.title: AWAY has a release date (and a new trailer as well)!
notes.notes:
Finally, the news you've all been waiting for... 

[previewyoutube=d8-bQaJE-rM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]AWAY will be releasing September 28, 2021![/b]

After years and years of development, we're so excited to hear what you think of our sugar glider and his journey through a wild world.

AWAY is a bit of a between-genres game; mostly an adventure game with platforming and nature sim aspects, it doesn't fit super clearly into one genre. So if you have any questions about the gameplay, hardware requirements, or anything else AWAY please let us know and we'll do our best to give (spoiler-free) responses! 

In these last couple weeks before release, wishlisting and spreading the word about AWAY are the best things you can do to help us out, and we can't thank you enough for your support :) 

See you soon, sugar gliders!

notes.title: Gameplay Reveal & Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Last weekend we partnered with IGN to unveil AWAY's new gameplay walkthrough at Gamescom. The video takes you through one of AWAY’s side quests and showcases some of the game’s new features and mechanics, such as:
[list]
[*] Fighting a scorpion
[*] Hunting for lizards
[*] Using the Sugar Glider's instinct
[*] Playing as a new creature... 👀
[/list]
You can check out the full walkthrough below:

[previewyoutube=6-GyY4y3ib4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Release Announcement[/h2]

Alongside the new gameplay walkthrough, we officially announced that [b]AWAY will be releasing in early 2021.[/b]

This is later than we had anticipated, but we want to make sure that AWAY lives up to the promise we've made you. The remaining 6-8 months will be spent polishing AWAY's animations and mechanics, fixing pesky bugs, and optimizing the game for all platforms. 

We're extremely grateful for your patience so far and we're excited to get the game in your hands!

Until then, keep an eye out for more updates as we get closer to launch, and let us know what kind of content you would like to see next! We would love to show you more of AWAY, so please share your ideas with us in the comments :)

~ the AWAY dev team
